name: RDYC C8: wind west (club course)
description: Start at 4 Hp 3p [4p] Hp finish at 4 (can also finish at H). 3.7 NM; shortened course 2.2 NM, finishing at RDYC 4 (4). Course Group C: short inshore courses with a committee boat, for light winds, used for all classes. Shorten course and lap times are not simulated.

provenance.document: Royal Dart Yacht Club, Sailing Programme 2026: Sailing Instructions 2026 and Course Appendix 2026
provenance.reference: Course Appendix 2026: Courses in Start Bay & River Dart, wind west, course C8 (page 24); marks, section 7 (page 21); start and finish lines, section 3 (page 20)
provenance.enteredBy: Claude (AI assistant), from the PDF the owner supplied on 3 Nov 2026
provenance.notes: Mark positions are the club's approximate positions. The committee boat's position is not in the document: the simulator places her (see the CB mark). Distance computed from the mark positions agrees with the stated distance within 0.15 NM. Awaiting a check by a named RDYC member against the document.

marks.name: Committee boat
marks.source: Course Appendix 3: the line runs between the committee boat's orange-flag staff and the course side of the ODM. Where she anchors is the race officer's choice on the day: the simulator places her square to the wind at the ODM, the line long enough for the fleet, in the deeper water (E).
